description: Customer portal (FDD 7.18, S11): the customer's home (what is on its way, what is on their site, what needs them), their requests, their equipment and their invoices; a request, its quote and its invoices each in a tab of their own; raising a request. New EquipRite's customer rules (resources/js/customerPortal.js); the steps that write to Fusion are left to New.
